title: The multiplicative Lipschitz bound as an inductive bias
abstract: arXiv:2603.28113v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the problem of training a neural network to minimize a loss function given a Lipschitz constraint. While the most obvious way to estimate the Lipschitz constant of a neural network is to multiply the Lipschitz constants of its layers, this bound, which we term the _trivial bound_, is often considered impractically loose. We show that, on the contrary, it can be more effective than state-of-the-art methods (Sandwich, Almost-Orthogonal Layers, Convex Potential Layers, and SDP-based Lipschitz Layers) for Lipschitz-constrained learning. Our method combines the trivial bound with a novel activation function (the quadrature nonlinearity) to achieve lower cross-entropy over most of the tested classification bounds. For autoencoders constrained to be nonexpansive in a learned norm, it achieves the lowest pixel reconstruction error at every tested bottleneck width, improving on PCA by 12--24%. translated_title: 乘性Lipschitz界作为一种归纳偏置
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在Lipschitz约束下训练神经网络以最小化损失函数的问题。虽然估计神经网络Lipschitz常数最直观的方法是将各层的Lipschitz常数相乘，但这个我们称为“平凡界”的估计通常被认为过于宽松而不实用。我们证明，恰恰相反，在Lipschitz约束学习中，它可以比最先进的方法（Sandwich、几乎正交层、凸势层以及基于SDP的Lipschitz层）更有效。我们的方法将平凡界与一种新型激活函数（求积非线性）相结合，在大多数测试的分类边界上实现了更低的交叉熵。对于在学习范数下约束为非扩张的自编码器，它在所有测试的瓶颈宽度下都实现了最低的像素重建误差，相比PCA提升了12-24%。我们的架构由级联组成（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出将看似宽松的乘性Lipschitz“平凡界”与新型求积非线性激活函数相结合，在Lipschitz约束学习中超越了Sandwich、凸势层等最先进方法，并在非扩张自编码器上实现了比PCA低12-24%的重建误差。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that the seemingly loose trivial multiplicative Lipschitz bound, combined with a novel quadrature nonlinearity activation, outperforms state-of-the-art Lipschitz-constrained learning methods and achieves 12-24% lower reconstruction error than PCA in nonexpansive autoencoders.
